claim: The 2024 Mihintale stele transmits a Theravada chronicle tradition in which Mahinda's mission arrives as a group of seven rather than as a lone monk.
bounded_by: This claim is about the tradition recorded in 2024, not independent evidence that the third-century-BCE mission occurred exactly as narrated.
notes: Confidence ceiling C for ancient sequence; opens the method/object-focus work rather than closing chronology.
